annotations.title: Look up a Korean road-name address

description: Normalize a Korean address using the Korean government road-name address data: returns road-name address, lot-number (jibun) address, postal code, building name and the official English road-name address. Does not return coordinates. The keyword is sent to the government address service via WIA Address. (한국어: 도로명·지번·우편번호·공식 영문 표기를 조회합니다.)

keyword.description: Korean address keyword, e.g. '서울 강남구 테헤란로 152' or '강남파이낸스센터'

name: address_korea_lookup
title: Look up a Korean road-name address
